reviews.title: Best workout app out there
reviews.text: I’ve been using Fight Camp for over five years. It’s the only workout routine/program/app I’ve ever used consistently. Before Fight Camp I’d do maybe one workout every couple weeks. With Fight Camp I’ve consistently averaged 3-4 *hard* workouts a week. I’ve seen my overall fitness improve beyond what I thought was possible. My body looks completely different now too. This is not a lame follow-along workout video from the 80s. The instructors will give you real instruction on technique and fight strategies. And somehow along the way you’ll get crazy fit too. This app has all the variety you need to keep you from getting bored or in a rut. They’ve got boxing, kickboxing, strength workouts with weights, conditioning workouts that are 100% scalable to your ability. I don’t have lower back pain anymore because this app actually trains your core so it’s useful for everyday life. As you can tell, I can’t say enough nice things about this app and the lifestyle it creates. Get it. You won’t regret it.

Overall, it’s a really good tool if you want to level up your striking at home and stay motivated.”

reviews.title: A Hot Mess Of A System
reviews.text:
This whole company doesn’t really have it together. Buggy app, poor trackers (which is surprising given that Hysko trackers are supposed to be the best there is but their partnership with FightCamp gives you cheap unprofessional tracking), Cheap Pakistan gloves offering no wrist support, poor feedback and protection, very cheap HRM hardware and easy wraps(fraying, poor sizing, stress points on hands where sewn, creating pain when punching) and the company proceeds to charge a premium for non premium items. 
And let’s get to the instruction part. What a hot mess!Programs do not build on the ones before it because it’s a different trainer for each part of a program. It’s so disjointed that it’s not even funny. One trainer, one program, how difficult is that? Apparently too difficult for “FightCamp”. I honestly can’t believe that Mike Tyson would invest in such a product. The profit over substance mentality is exhausting. The only real positive to this system is the ease into getting you moving and doing something with your body. But if you expect to learn any real fighting fundamentals or want to train in a legitimate program that builds real skills transferable to the ring or self protection, then pass on this system and look into programs like Corner(a professional system used in UK boxing gyms with incredibly accurate trackers and amazing programs). Fightcamp is a toy at best. If your just a fitness bloke then this is fine (but the base system only, trackers and bag, skip the accessories and bring your own).

reviews.title: Don’t buy their equipment as a gift
reviews.text: My husband wanted the new console for Christmas. Checked the website, can’t get just the console, so I shelled out almost $300 for the console and a bunch of equipment we already had. Fine, whatever, I guess. But then Fight Camp signed me up for a subscription that I didn’t agree to. When I tried to call them to get the charge reversed, I got an automated message that no agents were available and to call back later then the call disconnected. Never again will I buy anything from them.

reviews.title: Not for beginners!!!
reviews.text:
Very few workouts for actual beginners, both in technique and for general fitness. Under the conditioning workout tab for instance there are literally only 2 out of the 133 workouts available and neither are truly for beginners who are trying to build up stamina. Under kickboxing 16 of the 886 workouts, strength 7/180 etc....

Very disappointing for the price charged. If you are a newbie look elsewhere.

Also very cool how you can track your progress and stream your own playlist during workouts.  Also learn a ton which keeps me engaged and wanting to get my workouts in. Been using this for rite at 2 years now and see no end in my future. Love it.

reviews.title: Beautiful App—Exorbitant Start-Up cost
reviews.text: I started the app when more of the workouts were available for free. The video tutorials are wonderful: you can either pick a technique to practice with, or do full workouts. I would be more than happy to purchase the $40/month membership fee if it was available…However, you cannot do a membership without buying the $800 (yes, $800) start-up kit with a bag, gloves, and a console. The console is used for tracking at best. For reference, I got a bag and gloves for under $200 from Amazon. This made sense as my bag would remain outdoors and not expected to last long. The start-up cost and gate-keeping is exorbitant and ridiculous—who do they hope to sell to, Elon Musk? Certainly not the average American. It’s a shame, because the material is worthwhile and like I said, I’d be more than willing to pay a monthly membership…But not a $800 set, puh-leeze.

reviews.title: Excellent Workouts
reviews.text: I’m an older student, 72, I appreciate the stepwise approach and progression. You can repeat classes if you want to, all at your own pace. Definitely helps in staying in shape. Enjoy following my stats and progress. I highly recommend Fight Camp, their service support for any questions or concerns is outstanding.

reviews.title: I want to love it
reviews.text: So like so many others, the holiday discounts were too good to not order. I was so excited to get it and even though I have previous experience, I started with the beginner program. I love the classes but getting the trackers to connect is a huge issue. Now the console isn’t charging the trackers so I am still paying for the subscription and can’t use it as designed. They have turned off their phone service and the email responses are now supposed to come in 24-48 BUSINESS HOURS. I really want this to work, but I think there is a problem with the consoles the company is not being transparent about. Great concept if it worked.

reviews.text:
I’ve had fightcamp since 2020. Been using it off and on but it all felt really wonky to use needing an iPad or something to stream to tv. And the trackers never worked very well. 

Fast forward to today and holy cow did they listen to feedback. The new base also hooks up to the tv so you don’t need to figure out your own streaming platform, and the trackers get charged on the same base all with magnets. It’s amazing and they just work now. Pick up and go. No fighting with an iPad or phone and getting them paired.

So I’m really picky about attending a boxing “class.” My husband got me this for Christmas because we moved so far away from gyms out in the country. I have to say I love this app. coach Aaron is my favorite! Love the energy and positivity. He usually says something philosophical which is so typical of boxing. If you’re not sure, give it a try!

reviews.title: Needs improvement

I like the app so far but I feel like it  could use some much needed updates. 
For starters the punch trackers do not hold their charge. Say I charge them all night then take them with me in my gym bag. By the time I get to gym after work, the trackers are warning me they have a low battery before I’ve even started. Seems like they should have a pod like AirPods to hold their charge. 
2) I wish their was a calorie counter instead of just output
I wish their were more full body options or that they were easier to sort.

reviews.title: Pedro Hollywood Approves Fight Camp
reviews.text: Nothing can compare to an actual boxing gym but FightCamp definitely made it possible, they have even created a virtual setting to compete against an appointment. Fight camp conditions your body and mind for fitness and fighting, so when you decide to actually go to a gym and spar you have a good foundation to continue your journey. As an actor I’m always on the move but fight camp made the impossible possible as to when you come home from work, attending the kids, or a busy day you can’t make it to class or your coach cancelled, bad weather, or just want to releive stress FIGHTCAMP gives you the same work out at home at your convenience.

reviews.title: Best App For Home Workout!
reviews.text: I am so happy I downloaded this app. I can’t afford a club, and this is undeniably the best thing for those who can’t for whatever reason get to do it in person. Coach Tommy has been phenomenal, I feel like he’s really here with me.
